name: Taiwan
prevalence_note: 165 anti-fraud & CIB 2025-2026: fake police/prosecutor (安全帳戶・視訊筆錄), ATM/online-banking installment cancellation (解除分期付款・重複扣款), 7-11 賣貨便/好賣+ escrow verification + screen sharing, 'guess who' relative impersonation, fast-approval loan account-beautification scams, investment LINE groups, fake utility/ETC/parcel fee calls, and English NIA/ARC/Customs scams targeting foreign residents dominate.
cross_border_note: Overseas scam call centers frequently spoof Taiwan's +886 country code (such as +886 9 mobile numbers or +886 0 to +886 8 domestic area codes) or use hidden caller IDs. Under NCC directives, Chunghwa Telecom and major Taiwan carriers block spoofed +886 0–8 international landline calls and play a mandatory 7-second Mandarin and Taiwanese Hokkien anti-scam voice warning before connecting incoming +886 9 international calls, international calls to landlines, and hidden-number mobile calls.

scams.name: 假冒警察／檢察官／戶政事務所（安全帳戶・視訊筆錄）
scams.name_en: Fake police, prosecutor or household registry demanding safe account or video statement
scams.signals_en: Poses as household registry, police or prosecutor claiming the owner's ID or bank book appeared in a money-laundering case; demands secrecy, LINE video statement, cash handover to a clerk, or transfer to a supervised/safe account.
scams.legit_en: Real Taiwanese police, prosecutors or household offices send mailed summons to visit in person and never take LINE video statements, ask for secrecy, or inspect funds.
bait_tactics: 裝得很緊張配合，說存摺跟印章鎖在二樓鐵櫃裡、鑰匙塞在哪裡忘記了，請他等一下先慢慢講監管流程
故意聽錯案號或分機號碼，請他一個字一個字重新唸，順便細問公證金跟清查大概要幾天
說老花眼鏡找不到、手機字太小看不清楚，請他口頭一步一步慢慢教怎麼操作

scams.name: 假網拍買家／賣貨便・好賣+・旋轉拍賣金流認證
scams.name_en: 7-11 Maihuobian / FamilyMart / Carousell seller payout verification & screen-sharing scam
scams.signals_en: Claims buyer could not check out on 7-11 Maihuobian, FamilyMart Haomai+ or Carousell because the seller lacks payout/escrow verification; fake bank agent calls to guide online banking transfer or LINE screen sharing.
scams.legit_en: Real marketplace support never calls via LINE or phone to verify seller bank balances, transfer test codes, or share screens.
bait_tactics: 裝作剛開始在網路賣二手東西很怕弄錯，慢慢問那個金流認證是一次性還是每筆都要簽
假裝網銀 App 一直卡在更新轉圈圈或密碼打錯被鎖住，問能不能換郵局存摺慢慢對
故意把轉帳驗證欄位講成備註欄，請他從頭再講一次步驟
假裝沒用過台灣Pay找不到綁定畫面，請他從下載哪一個圖示開始慢慢教

scams.name: 假冒電商與銀行客服（解除分期付款・誤設重複扣款）
scams.name_en: Fake e-commerce and bank support ATM or online-banking installment cancellation scam
scams.signals_en: Impersonates e-commerce, ticketing, or charity staff claiming an internal clerical error set the buyer's past order to recurring installments, duplicate charges, VIP membership, or wholesale billing...
scams.legit_en: ATMs and online-banking transfer screens in Taiwan only send money out and can never cancel installment settings, reverse duplicate charges, or verify identity via transfer codes.
bait_tactics: 假裝完全想不起來買過哪一樣商品，請他把訂單品項、顏色跟出貨日期一項一項慢慢唸出來核對
說家裡附近巷口的提款機剛好貼維修公告，走路去下一間超商要十幾分鐘，請他在線上等一下順便解釋為什麼銀行不能自己取消
假裝進到網路銀行畫面但一直找不到什麼沖正代碼欄位，故意問是不是寫著轉出帳號那一格

scams.name: 猜猜我是誰／假冒親友換新號碼急墊貨款
scams.name_en: 'Guess who' relative claiming broken phone or new number and asking urgent loan or supplier payment
scams.signals_en: Cold-calls pretending to be a child, nephew/niece, or old friend who dropped or broke their phone and changed numbers, asks the victim to add a new LINE account, and soon pleads for an urgent supplier payment or bridge transfer into a third-party 'friend's...
scams.legit_en: Genuine relatives borrowing money can be reached via their original phone number or verified through other family members and do not insist on wiring funds to unrelated third-party accounts.
bait_tactics: 順著話氣裝熟，故意問上次家族聚餐帶回家的那盒伴手禮吃完了沒，看他怎麼圓謊
說存摺放在另一半那邊保管，堅持要先暫停打原本舊號碼或問家裡其他人確認一下
慢慢問這筆貨款到底是進什麼貨、為什麼廠商帳戶的名字聽起來完全不認識

scams.name: 假借貸／免聯徵快速核貸／美化帳戶
scams.name_en: Fast-approval loan advance-fee or bank-account beautification scam
scams.signals_en: Promises guaranteed no-credit-check loan or debt consolidation, then asks to add LINE, pay an upfront guarantee/unlock fee, or mail ATM cards/passbooks to 'beautify cashflow'.
scams.legit_en: Real bank staff following up on a loan the owner actually applied for never ask for ATM cards, passwords, LINE fees, or cashflow packaging.
bait_tactics: 裝作剛好想整修房子很想借，但算術很慢，一直請他重算本利攤還每個月到底幾塊錢
慢慢問提前清償違約金怎麼算、開辦費能不能直接從撥款裡面扣、要準備哪些財力證明
假裝手邊沒有紙筆，請他等我翻抽屜找原子筆把方案一個字一個字抄下來

scams.name: 假冒台電・台水・ETC・健保・郵局包裹欠費斷電通知
scams.name_en: Fake Taipower, water, ETC toll, NHI card or Chunghwa Post urgent fee/cut-off call
scams.signals_en: Claims electricity/water will be cut off within hours, NHI card is locked for illegal drug claims, or ETC/parcel needs instant link payment or transfer to personal/virtual account.
scams.legit_en: Polite utility, building-management or courier calls merely reminding the owner to pay at a convenience store or official app by month-end with no cut-off threat, link or card request.
bait_tactics: 裝緊張說家裡冰箱塞滿冷凍年菜不能斷電，假裝翻抽屜找上個月的水電單核對電號
故意報錯地址樓層或車牌號碼，請他幫我查看到底是登記在誰名下
問能不能現在走路去巷口超商印單子繳，請他先別掛電話等我穿鞋子找零錢
假裝記不清楚哪一天上國道，請他幫忙查車牌跟經過哪個收費站

scams.name: 飆股老師帶單／抽籤申購墊付／虛擬幣穩賺群組
scams.name_en: Fake stock guru, IPO lottery margin or crypto guaranteed-profit LINE group
scams.signals_en: Pitches guaranteed-win stock club, unlimited IPO share lottery requiring urgent top-up transfer to avoid default, or cash courier deposit into a trading app.
scams.legit_en: Licensed Taiwanese securities brokers never guarantee profits, pool funds in private apps, or send cash couriers.
bait_tactics: 裝作手頭有一筆定存快到期很有興趣，但聽不懂股票術語，請他從什麼是融資跟抽籤慢慢解釋
一直問萬一跌了怎麼辦、獲利分成怎麼算、能不能先小額試個三千塊看看流程

scams.name: Fake NIA / Taiwan Customs / Bank English Scam Targeting Foreign Residents
scams.name_en: English-language fake National Immigration Agency, Customs parcel or ARC misuse scam
scams.signals_en: Targets foreign residents and students in Taiwan in English, posing as the National Immigration Agency (NIA), Customs Administration, or a local bank; alleges the recipient's ARC number was used to mail contraband or open a mule account...
scams.legit_en: Taiwan's National Immigration Agency, Customs Administration (EZ WAY), and police never threaten immediate ARC cancellation by phone, transfer calls to overseas police, or ask foreign residents to transfer funds for investigation.
bait_tactics: Sorry, the signal in my apartment stairwell is really choppy right now—could you spell out your service center address slowly?
Hold on, my ARC card is locked in my desk at the office; let me walk to the local immigration service station in person tomorrow morning to check.
I use the official EZ WAY app for parcels and nothing shows up there, so can you repeat the airway bill letters one by one?
